ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the sea water isotherm map and complete the following questions. <image1> If ocean current 2 in the figure is located in the Atlantic Ocean, which ocean current might it be?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has a schematic diagram of sea water isotherms, and the question focuses on the ocean current labeled "2" on the right side. The water temperatures marked on the right side of the figure from top to bottom are 22℃, 20℃, and 18℃, indicating that the upper sea water in the figure is warmer and the lower sea water is colder; near "2", the isotherms bulge along the vicinity of the dashed line toward the upper, warmer, lower-latitude direction. Then reason: Warm above and cold below indicates that this sea area is in the Southern Hemisphere; the isotherms bulging toward warm water or the low-latitude direction indicates that colder sea water is advancing toward low latitudes, so 2 is a cold current. If this cold current is located in the Atlantic Ocean, it corresponds to the cold current in the eastern South Atlantic—the Benguela Cold Current.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the sea water isotherm map and complete the following questions.

<image1>

If ocean current 2 in the figure is located in the Atlantic Ocean, which ocean current might it be?

method.method_draft: 根据右图2处温度分布，先判断其位于南半球海域；再依据2附近等温线向暖水/低纬方向凸出，判定2为寒流。题干限定其位于大西洋，因此对应南大西洋的寒流名称为本格拉寒流。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中有海水等温线示意，题目关注右侧标有“2”的洋流。该图右边标注的水温从上到下依次为22℃、20℃、18℃，说明图中上方海水较暖、下方海水较冷；在“2”附近，等温线沿虚线附近向上方较暖、较低纬方向凸出。再推理：上暖下冷表示该海域位于南半球；等温线向暖水或低纬方向凸出，说明较冷海水向低纬推进，因此2为寒流。若该寒流位于大西洋，则对应南大西洋东部的寒流——本格拉寒流。
